title: KabOCR: open OCR for Kabyle (Latin script) — web app, model, command line and evaluation toolkit
description:
KabOCR is free OCR for Kabyle (Taqbaylit) in Latin script.

  • A web application that runs entirely in the browser (PDF or image in, text and searchable PDF out): https://yulliwasameur.github.io/kabocr/
  • The KabOCR-Free v0.1 Tesseract model, trained only on openly licensed text (weights under CC BY-SA 4.0). It reaches 0.90 / 0.75 / 1.70 % character error rate on unseen real theses and books, against 1.45 / 1.36 / 2.58 % for the best public model measured.
  • A command-line tool.
  • kabocr-eval, an evaluation toolkit that reports CER, WER and DCER (errors on Kabyle-specific letters, split into missed and spurious), handles homoglyphs, applies ground-truth quality rules and computes document-level statistics.
  • The research scripts that reproduce the results.

Page images and texts of copyrighted documents, and the models trained on them, are not included.
